page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head top left, page number top right. No marginal notes. Catchword "Bona" at the foot right, with a signature mark "L" at the foot left.

l.i: quia nihil fecimus ultra id quod debuimus: atque ita nihil inde petere

main_text.l: debemus, ultra mercedem ex pacto adjunctam. Sic ille, tanquam ex Augustino,
ubi nihil quicquam tale occurrit, nec in ullo
istorum Sermonum de verbis Domini, qui ibi extant quinquaginta.
mus, inquit, Non dixit, DICITE, SERVI IN-
ut humiliter de nobis sentiamus. Rectissimè
omnia commenta vestra hactenus sunt foedae
effugere possitis; quam idcirco nos latius
fecerimus; & non separari ab obligatione praecepti,
non expendente pro Christo: & Rom. 8. 13. de
iis qui mortificant, & qui non mortificant

page.notes: The "Nostri" word in the first line of the running head is set in the usual running head type; "Sect.2." is kept as printed. The scan is faint at the left edge and the lower left corner; the readings there are good but the italic letters in "nostri" and "possitis" are slightly blurred. A stray mark ("/") sits below the last line and is not text. Show-through from the reverse side is visible in the right margin and was left out.
